copy.description:
Riding with a dog or cat in the car is easier with a tether you can adjust to fit. This 2-pack of pet car seatbelts has an adjustable length of 16.93 to 27.17 inches (430 to 690 mm) and a 0.98-inch (25 mm) wide strap, according to the maker's specifications. The maker lists the material as nylon, and the specification shows black. The listed weight for the pack is 454 g, about 1 lb.

Attach this seatbelt to a well-fitted harness, not a collar. It is not a crash restraint. Check the adjustment and harness fit before every trip, and keep your pet supervised in the vehicle at all times.

Ships from a US warehouse, and the shipping window is listed in the FAQ below.

faq.a: No. It is not a crash restraint. Attach it to a well-fitted harness and keep your pet supervised in the vehicle.

faq.q: Can I clip it to my pet's collar?
faq.a: No. Attach it to a well-fitted harness, not a collar.
Estimate: 3–5 days to the US after 1–3 days of processing. Ships from a US warehouse.

copy.safety_warning: Attach to a well-fitted harness, not a collar. This product is not a crash restraint. Check the adjustment and harness fit before every trip and supervise your pet in the vehicle at all times.
